pkgmetadata.longdescription: ASGI middleware that attaches a correlation/request ID to every log message for a given request. Works with FastAPI, Starlette, and any ASGI-compatible framework. Supports propagating IDs from incoming request headers (e.g. X-Request-ID) and forwarding them in responses.

use.flag: Forward correlation IDs to Sentry error reports via sentry-sdk
